brief:
Palestinians use local radio stations to communicate about and navigate the realities of Israeli occupation and settler attacks, according to Al Jazeera English. The broadcast medium serves as a critical information source for communities facing restrictions on movement and periodic violence from settlers.

Radio allows Palestinians to share real-time updates on security threats, checkpoint locations, and conditions across occupied territories, providing a communication channel that reaches communities with varying access to internet and mobile networks. The stations also document settler violence and occupation-related developments for local audiences.
dek: Al Jazeera’s Nida Ibrahim explains how Palestinians use local radio to navigate Israel's occupation and settler pogroms.
title: Palestinians rely on radio to navigate occupation and settler violence
